title: AusTalk, the Big Australian Speech Corpus

version.label: collection as formerly distributed through the Alveo Virtual Laboratory

citation: Burnham, Denis et al. AusTalk: an audio-visual corpus of Australian English. LREC 2014.

governance.retention_or_deletion_duties: Do not acquire, retain, upload or process source data while the recorded rights state blocks use.

population.description: Audio and video recordings of about one thousand speakers of Australian English across scripted, spontaneous and dialogue tasks.
limitations: No access route exists, so what its manual annotation contains cannot be inspected and fails closed.
Audio visual recordings of identifiable participants would need their own privacy review before any use, if a route reopened.
This is the Australian corpus this project would most want and cannot have. It is recorded so nobody spends a second week rediscovering it.

annotation.provenance: No annotations acquired; published descriptions were read.
limitations: No source record may enter engineering while access or rights remain blocked.

inspected_materials: Published corpus descriptions from the project partners.
Domain name resolution for the former distribution hosts, checked 2026-07-29.
findings: alveo.edu.au, app.alveo.edu.au, austalk.edu.au and bigasc.edu.au all failed to resolve on 2026-07-29.
The Language Data Commons of Australia catalogue does not list the collection, so the successor archive did not ingest it.
There is no application form, no registration and no click through, so this is unobtainable rather than pending.

participant_split.source_split_provenance: No source participant data is acquired or approved.

lineage.duplicate_detection: Required if rights later permit acquisition.
